newEntry.name: Trace & Tally
newEntry.desc: Snip sixteen runners, seat a flat axle and side-insert a keeper to build a four-part rolling-distance kit. Customize a graduated wheel, handle and calibrated bearing; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief or verified ASCII/binary STL handle marks, connected-card and per-part STL/ZIP. Fixed joints need adhesive; calibrate against a known path, not a precision instrument.
